test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anurag said to me, “I am going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.”

options.text: Anurag told me that he was going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.
Anurag asked me if I was going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.
Anurag told me that he is going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.
Anurag told me that I am going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Anurag told me that he was going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said to' changes to 'told' in the indirect speech part.
 
• The pronoun 'I' changes to 'he' in the indirect speech.
 
• If the direct speech is written in the **present continuous** tense, then we have to **change it into past continuous** in the indirect speech. therefore:
 
 
• The verb 'is going' in the direct speech changes to 'was going' in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• The inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the preposition 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

The indirect sentence is: *Anurag told me that he was going to the store to buy milk and vegetables.*
